title: Chapter 1317 - 4: The Eighth Physical Body Divine Ability

Chapter 1317 - 4: The Eighth Physical Body Divine Ability

Chapter 1317: Chapter 4: The Eighth Physical Body Divine Ability

In the upcoming future timelines, the likelihood of Lin Yuan coming into contact with time life forms exceeds ninety percent.

The reason is estimated to involve the previous owner of the jade gourd, that is, the Thirteen-level time life form.

Lin Yuan’s expression showed an understanding, Thirteen-level time life forms can observe numerous future timelines.

But among different timelines, it involves the will of each Thirteen-level.

Once interactions with time life forms occur in future timelines, the choice of each Thirteen-level will create different futures.

Just like Lin Yuan now.

After realizing that he would soon have contact with the Thirteen-level, he can choose to meet.

Or choose not to meet.

The outcome is all on Lin Yuan himself. "Let’s meet."

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged in the Desolate Void.

He didn’t plan to avoid the Thirteen-level time life form of the Chaos Void.

Since the other party has taken notice of him, they must have also seen the past and the future.

There’s no need to hide.

Moreover, with Lin Yuan’s current strength and combat ability, with full force, he is not weaker than a conventional Thirteen-level time life form.

Not to mention the numerous means of saving his life.

Especially the true selves of the other two Origin Source worlds. ...

The Chaos Qi floated around.

Lin Yuan sat there quietly.

Different feelings surged in his heart.

In the second Origin Source world, thirteen Eternal Lords approached him.

Lin Yuan was completely unaware beforehand.

In the first Origin Source world, several Ancestors visited.

If not for the Ancestor of Fierce Sun informing him,

Lin Yuan wouldn’t have known either.

However, this time, he knew in advance that a Thirteen-level time life form was coming to meet him.

He waited here early.

This sense of control, from the future he had chosen for himself, deeply moved Lin Yuan.

A moment later, the surrounding space-time subtly solidified.

Seven figures quietly appeared not far from Lin Yuan. "Galaxy." The leading ’Lord Mo Xu’ spoke, warmly greeting.

The faces of the six time life forms behind him showed friendly smiles.

Perceiving Lin Yuan’s limitless future potential, almost certain to become a Time Lord, these time life forms naturally first thought to proactively build an alliance.

As for becoming enemies?

The outcome of becoming enemies in future timelines is considered extremely tragic.

No time life form has the courage to be an enemy of Lin Yuan.

At the Thirteen-level, there is simply no meaningless fighting and killing between time life forms. "Greetings, great time life forms."

Lin Yuan steadied himself, immediately stood up, and said.

The seven figures before him were exactly the seven time life forms of the Chaos Void. "Great?" "In front of you, Galaxy, we are not considered great."

The time life form with the head of a human and the body of a snake smiled and spoke, the tone was heartfelt.

In the eyes of life forms below the Thirteen-level, time life forms are incredibly great, but to Lin Yuan?

The time life forms have seen the result of their battles with Lin Yuan and the outcome of facing Lin Yuan’s reckoning thousands of years later. "How fortunate it is that our dimension space gave birth to you, Galaxy."

The leading ’Lord Mo Xu’ looked at Lin Yuan, smiling, and said, "Speaking of which, Galaxy, you and I are somewhat fated, with the method of ’Infinite Void’ you practiced early on..."

The other six time life forms’ expressions slightly changed upon hearing this.

The implication of Lord Mo Xu’s words was obviously to establish a connection with Lin Yuan. "The ’Infinite Void’ is profound and extensive, and has been of great help to me."

Lin Yuan nodded in agreement.

At least before and after leaving his native universe, the Thirteen-level inheritance ’Infinite Void’ greatly aided him.

Until ten thousand years ago, ’Infinite Void’ was about to step into the fifth layer, Lin Yuan fused with the perfect aspects of the other two Origin Source worlds within his body universe, allowing this inheritance to transcend its original state completely. "As long as it’s helpful." ’Lord Mo Xu’ smiled, then turned his right hand, and six other special items appeared before him. "These are the other six ultimate inheritances that I created while establishing the ’Infinite Void’ heritage, I hope they are useful to you, Galaxy." ’Lord Mo Xu’ said. "The other six inheritances?"

Lin Yuan looked at the six floating special items, feeling slightly moved in his heart.

Together with ’Infinite Void,’ the seven represent the seven ultimate Thirteen-level inheritances, which are the path ’Lord Mo Xu’ is on.

Each inheritance is divided into seven layers, of which the seventh layer is theoretical.

Once all seven inheritances are cultivated to the seventh layer, it will be when ’Lord Mo Xu’ becomes the Time Lord. "Thank you."

Lin Yuan accepted without declining, directly receiving all six special items.

They could indeed provide him with some help, at least as a reference.

In terms of foundational roots, he had long transcended the ’Infinite Void’ itself, but the ultimate aspects in other areas were still worth looking into. "It’s just a small matter." ’Lord Mo Xu’ smiled and said. ...

What followed next.

The other six Time Lifeforms each presented some treasures and rare items.

Among the seven Time Lifeforms, Lin Yuan quickly found the owner of the Sky Void Tripod.

And casually returned the Sky Void Tripod back to them.

Now, this thirteen-tier weapon didn’t have much utility for her.

To unleash a full-power strike from the Sky Void Tripod was not vastly different in potency compared to Lin Yuan’s own full-power strike.

This was even before Lin Yuan had stepped into the thirteenth tier; once becoming a Time Lifeform, the Sky Void Tripod would likely become redundant.

In fact, for the owner of the Sky Void Tripod, its usefulness wasn’t great either; otherwise, it wouldn’t have been left lost outside. ...

After getting acquainted with Lin Yuan, the seven Time Lifeforms visibly relaxed quite a bit. "Galaxy, once you step into the thirteenth tier, you can join us in exploring that dimensional space."

Lord Mo Xu looked at Lin Yuan and said with a smile, "That dimensional space is immense, even beyond the Chaos Void, but it is also very chaotic, and the conscious pathway operating it is close to collapse, so it doesn’t reject us entering." "However, precisely because of this, many Time Lifeforms have battled in that dimensional space. The rare operation of its pathways greatly benefits our cultivation."

The other six Time Lifeforms looked at Lin Yuan.

That incredibly chaotic dimensional space bore traces laid by numerous Time Lifeforms. The seven Time Lifeforms of the Chaos Void banded together there, forming a tremendously formidable force. "A dimensional space that doesn’t reject outsiders?"

Lin Yuan was quite surprised in his heart.

But he quickly accepted it.

Throughout the endless dimensions, there exist one-dimensional spaces.

Dimensional spaces naturally repel outside life, but if this repulsive nature is erased, then naturally there is no more repulsion.

However, achieving this is extremely difficult, requiring at least the unopposed effort of the Time Lord tier and great cost. "I’ll consider it once I step into the thirteenth tier."

Lin Yuan said.

He had some interest in the non-repelling dimensional space.

But it was just interest, not greatly alluring to him.

A non-repelling dimensional space meant that many Time Lifeforms had entered it prior to Lin Yuan.

The benefits within have been mostly scavenged, making it more worthwhile to explore the subsequent Origin Worlds.

Only at this moment, Lin Yuan realized the immense value of those thirty-three Origin World coordinates deep within the Myriad Realms Gate.

A dimensional space explored many times by numerous Time Lifeforms, even to the seven Time Lifeforms of the Chaos Void, is considered a great opportunity.

And Lin Yuan had control over exactly thirty-three of such dimensional spaces, all suitable for perfect assimilation. "Hmm." "Then let’s see at that time." "We await Galaxy’s step into the thirteenth tier."

Lord Mo Xu dared to invite Lin Yuan, possessing some confidence.

That dimensional space was extremely chaotic; ordinary Time Lifeforms would definitely be suppressed by other Time Lifeforms upon entering, while the six of them had been settling there for a long time.

Once Lin Yuan went over, he would immediately enjoy various benefits. ...

They continued conversing for a while.

Only then did the seven Time Lifeforms take their leave one by one.

The void where Lin Yuan was rapidly returned to its original state.

Nobody knew, just a moment ago, this seemingly unremarkable Desolate Void hosted the arrival of seven Time Lifeforms. "Yin Yang Flower."

Lin Yuan’s gaze deepened, looking toward the mysterious dimensional gap outside, with the Taiji Primordial Spirit now close to the position of the Yin Yang Flower.

Once this dimensional treasure was in hand, Lin Yuan’s Chaotic Taiji Dao could quickly advance to the third tier. ...

The second Origin World.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged. "Demonic Qi?"

Lin Yuan focused part of his mind on observing the demonic qi of the Fang Yuan World.

The so-called Demonic Qi is one of the origin powers of the Lord of Heaven Light, foundational to the Black Demon form. "Demon God?"

Lin Yuan faintly sensed the precise location of the Demon God, residing within the Origin Source of the Fang Yuan World, striving to suppress the world’s consciousness and attempt assimilation with demonic qi. "Lord of Heaven Light... extraordinary."

Lin Yuan became increasingly aware of this Time Lord’s methods.

The operation of an Origin World’s consciousness is such that ordinary Time Lifeforms couldn’t suppress or even affect it.

But the Black Demon form of the Lord of Heaven Light was almost able to accomplish this through mere instinct, although achieving total suppression of the Origin World’s will is still a distant goal.

Yet it is at least hopeful. "Hmm?"

Just then, as Lin Yuan continued to observe the entire Origin World’s demonic qi.

He suddenly felt a stirring inside.

He saw in the depths of Lin Yuan’s blood, strands of fundamental power intertwining and colliding as though approaching the final stage, with all fundamental forces rapidly merging, ultimately forming an extremely complex mark seemingly containing innumerable times and spaces. "Divine Power Imprint?"

Lin Yuan was shaken.

He immediately realized his eighth Physical Body Divine Ability had finally birthed and awakened.

The birth and awakening of the eighth Physical Body Divine Ability had cost Lin Yuan over ten thousand years.

The reason being that when the Lord of Heaven Light struck that step, even though it ultimately failed, the burning of mental and spiritual will broke some boundary.

Causing the life of the Fang Yuan World to experience significantly increased physical potential.

The physical body Lin Yuan descended upon benefited from this, with the foundational power of the Martial Arts Evolution Road tempering and touching upon even higher levels of fundamental lineage.

Thus, the Divine Skills Imprint was condensed after such a prolonged time. "I wonder what this Physical Body Divine Ability will be like?"

Lin Yuan’s eyes were full of expectation, his mind merged into the Divine Skills Imprint.
